```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

# Packages ---------------------------------------------------------------

library(tidyverse)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(ggiraph)
library(ggsketch)
library(ggtext)
library(scales)
library(showtext)

# Fonts ------------------------------------------------------------------

font_add_google("Nunito Sans", family = "font_body")
showtext_auto()

# Data -------------------------------------------------------------------

performance_by_first_language <- readr::read_csv(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2026/2026-08-18/performance_by_first_language.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Miscs ------------------------------------------------------------------

color_paper <- "#f7f1e3"
color_ink <- "#24303a"
color_academic <- "#2c6e6a"
color_general <- "#f2b5a0"
color_chart_paper <- "#ffffff"
color_chart_grid <- "#dfe3e6"
color_dot_stroke <- "#f8faf8"

theme_set(
  theme_sketch(
    base_family = "font_body",
    base_size = 14,
    rough_frame = FALSE,
    roughness = 0.35,
    seed = 42
  ) +
    theme(
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = color_paper, color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = color_paper, color = NA),
      plot.title = element_text(color = color_ink),
      plot.subtitle = ggtext::element_markdown(
        color = color_ink,
        size = 13.5,
        lineheight = 1.2,
        margin = margin(b = 16)
      ),
      plot.caption = element_text(
        color = alpha(color_ink, 0.72),
        size = 10,
        hjust = 0,
        margin = margin(t = 14)
      ),
      axis.title = element_text(color = color_ink, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(color = color_ink),
      strip.text = element_text(color = color_ink),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(
        color = color_chart_grid,
        linewidth = 0.35
      ),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.justification = "left",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.background = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(18, 28, 18, 18)
    )
)
```

## How test types overlap

```{r}
#| label: skill-type-beeswarm
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 7
#| fig-align: center

# Data -------------------------------------------------------------------

plot_data <- performance_by_first_language |>
  filter(
    year == "2024-2025",
    part != "overall"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    part = factor(
      part,
      levels = c("writing", "speaking", "reading", "listening"),
      labels = c("Writing", "Speaking", "Reading", "Listening")
    ),
    type = recode(
      type,
      Academic = "Academic",
      General_Training = "General Training"
    ),
    type = factor(type, levels = c("Academic", "General Training")),
    tooltip_background = if_else(
      type == "Academic",
      color_academic,
      color_general
    ),
    tooltip_text = if_else(
      type == "Academic",
      "#ffffff",
      color_ink
    ),
    tooltip = str_glue(
      "<div style='background:{tooltip_background};color:{tooltip_text};",
      "padding:8px 11px;border-radius:6px;",
      "font-family:Arial,system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:13px;line-height:1.4;'>",
      "<strong>{language}</strong><br>",
      "{part} · {type}<br>",
      "Average band: {number(score, accuracy = 0.01)}</div>"
    ),
    data_id = str_c(type, language, part, sep = "__")
  )

# Texts ------------------------------------------------------------------

title_text <- "The four skills tell very different stories"
subtitle_text <- str_c(
  "Across both ",
  "<span style='color:", color_academic, "'><b>Academic</b></span> and ",
  "<span style='color:", color_general, "'><b>General Training</b></span>, ",
  "Reading and Listening vary most<br>",
  "across first languages, while Writing is tightly clustered."
)
caption_text <- "Source: IELTS / TidyTuesday 2026-08-18 | Graphic: Deepali Kank"

# Plots ------------------------------------------------------------------

p <- plot_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = score, y = part, fill = type)) +
  ggiraph::geom_point_interactive(
    aes(tooltip = tooltip, data_id = data_id),
    position = ggbeeswarm::position_quasirandom(
      width = 0.3,
      orientation = "y",
      dodge.width = 0.34
    ),
    shape = 21,
    size = 3.8,
    color = color_dot_stroke,
    alpha = 0.9,
    stroke = 0.55
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Academic" = color_academic,
      "General Training" = color_general
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(4, 8.5, by = 0.5),
    limits = c(3.75, 8.5),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.02))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = title_text,
    subtitle = subtitle_text,
    x = "Average band score",
    y = NULL,
    caption = caption_text
  ) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "font_body"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = color_chart_paper, color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = color_chart_paper, color = NA),
    plot.title = element_text(
      family = "font_body",
      face = "bold",
      size = 25,
      margin = margin(b = 8)
    ),
    plot.subtitle = ggtext::element_markdown(
      family = "font_body",
      color = color_ink,
      size = 13.5,
      hjust = 0,
      halign = 0,
      lineheight = 1.25,
      margin = margin(b = 18)
    ),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(
      color = color_chart_grid,
      linewidth = 0.45
    ),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  )

svg_path <- here::here(
  "plots",
  "2026",
  "svg",
  "tt_2026_w33_skill_type_beeswarm.svg"
)

ggsave(
  filename = svg_path,
  plot = p,
  width = 10,
  height = 7,
  bg = color_chart_paper
)

ggiraph::girafe(
  ggobj = p,
  width_svg = 10,
  height_svg = 7,
  options = list(
    ggiraph::opts_hover(
      css = "fill-opacity:1;stroke:#24303a;stroke-width:1.5px;cursor:pointer;"
    ),
    ggiraph::opts_hover_inv(css = "opacity:0.32;"),
    ggiraph::opts_tooltip(
      css = str_c(
        "background:transparent;color:inherit;padding:0;border:0;",
        "border-radius:6px;",
        "box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(36,48,58,0.22);"
      ),
      opacity = 0.98
    ),
    ggiraph::opts_sizing(rescale = TRUE, width = 1),
    ggiraph::opts_toolbar(saveaspng = FALSE)
  )
)
```
